title: Spicy Soba Noodle Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful Chinese-inspired stir fry made with soba noodles, hearty vegetables, and savory sauce.

ingredients.name: Hearty
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and broccoli

instructions: Cook soba noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the char and cook for 2-3 minutes, until browned and crispy.
Add the hearty vegetables and cook until they begin to soften.
Add the soy sauce, maple syrup, ginger, and garlic to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the cooked soba noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce and vegetables.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
